raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly inferred that Wahab Riaz is a left-handed batsman based solely on the BBC article describing him as a "left-arm paceman." In cricket terminology, "left-arm" refers exclusively to the bowling hand, not the batting hand. The subsequent search results (All Out Cricket, CREX, Cricket.com.au) clearly and consistently identified his batting style as "Right Hand Bat." The Planner failed to distinguish between bowling and batting handedness, leading to the wrong conclusion of "left-hand" despite the available evidence pointing to "right-hand."
